d: UNSC colonial star systems in the Halo universe.

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Primary naval hub of the UNSC Inner Colonies and site of the Fall of Reach in 2552.

canon-halo:reach.x: Fortress world and second planet of Epsilon Eridani; headquarters of UNSC FLEETCOM and the SPARTAN-II program before its glassing by the Covenant.

gaia-6412595290592307840.x: Agricultural UNSC Outer Colony orbiting Epsilon Indi; site of humanity’s first contact with the Covenant in 2525.

gaia-6226694571859532800.x: Resource-rich UNSC Outer Colony and Insurrectionist stronghold in the 23 Librae system.

hip-37279.x: Lush UNSC tourism and resort colony in the Procyon system besieged during Halo Wars (2531).

gaia-2452378776434477184.x: Strategic inner-colony frontier sector in the Halo UNSC astrometric network.

b.s: Military science-fiction universe in which the United Nations Space Command (UNSC) colonises real nearby stars within the local 50-parsec solar neighbourhood, anchored by the fortress world Reach in the Epsilon Eridani system.
b.r: Halo Encyclopedia (Dark Horse Books, 2022) & Halo: The Fall of Reach (2001)
